# The Impact of Digital Coaching Intervention for Improving Healthy Ageing Dimensions among Older Adults during Their Transition from Work to Retirement

**Авторы:** Santini Sara, Fabbietti Paolo, Galassi Flavia, Merizzi Alessandra, Kropf Johannes, Hungerländer Niklas, Stara Vera

**Журнал:** International Journal of Environmental Research and Public Health (2023)

**DOI:** 10.3390/ijerph20054034

source_units.text:
Abstract

Retirement is a critical step in older adults’ lives, so it is important to motivate them to stay physically active, mentally healthy, and socially connected in the transition from work to retirement, including through digital health coaching programs. This study aims to: evaluate the impact of a digital coaching intervention to enhance three healthy ageing dimensions, i.e., physical activity, mental well-being, and socialization of a group of adults near retirement; understand the users’ experience; and identify the system strengths and weaknesses. This longitudinal mixed-methods study, carried out in 2021 in Italy and the Netherlands, enrolled 62 individuals. In the first 5 weeks of the trial, participants used a digital coach with the support of human coaches, and then they continued autonomously for another 5 weeks.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The use of the digital coach improved the participants’ physical activity, mental well-being and self-efficacy during the first period and only the physical activity in the second.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: An effective coaching system should be flexible and attractive.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: High levels of personalization remain the golden key to aligning the health program to the physical, cognitive and social status of the intended target, thus increasing the user-system interaction, usability, and acceptability, as well as enhancing adherence to the intervention.

source_units.text:
Introduction

We are witnessing the rapid ageing of the world population.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The extension of life expectancy often means a prolonged disability condition in later life that is placing questions on long-term care systems across the world.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The ageing of the population also entails the transition of many older adults from the status of workers to that of retirees.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The literature now agrees that retirement is a critical step in people’s lives, full of opportunities and, at the same time, fraught with dangers [1,2].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: In fact, alongside the greater availability of free time and the opportunity to use it in many activities, e.g., cultural and physical, the loss of meaningful relationships and interests can creep in, forcing older individuals to re-organize their daily schedule, re-negotiate their roles in the family and in society, and re-design, at least partly, their own identity [3].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Thus, the transition to retirement can represent the tipping point for healthy ageing or its opposite, based on the individuals’ response to this existential change.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Healthy ageing is defined as “the process of developing and maintaining the functional ability (i.e., people’s capabilities of being and doing what they have reason to value) that enables well-being in older age” [4], whose main predictors are physical activity, mental well-being, and social participation [5,6].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: There is a lack of consensus on how the retirement transition can affect older adults’ physical activity [7,8,9,10].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: On the one hand, according to the activity theory, retirement may be an opportunity to increase physical activity.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: On the other hand, the literature underlines that during the retirement transition [11], there could be a fluctuation in the levels of intensity of, and in the motivation to do, physical activity, and a change in their types, which may be affected by gender as well.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: For example, according to a recent qualitative longitudinal study, the main driver of physical activity seems to be body shaping among men and socialization [12] among women.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Retirement can also influence individuals’ mental well-being and socialization.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: In fact, weaker and rarer meaningful social relationships, or a change in self-image, self-esteem, and self-efficacy [3] due to the end of the working life, can lead to social isolation, emotional discomfort, and depression [13].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Considering the above, it is very important to motivate older adults in the transition to retirement to stay physically active, mentally healthy, and socially connected so that they can age healthily and re-shape their own role in society without negative repercussions on their physical and mental health.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required
empty_or_punctuation_fragment

source_units.text: Health coaching interventions led by human coaches can motivate older adults to have healthier lifestyles in later life, for example, by eating more vegetables, practicing physical activity, and reducing cigarette smoking.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Such programs often target individuals with chronic diseases and are aimed at helping patients determine and work toward their goals so that they become more compliant with the health program [14,15,16,17,18].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Health coaching programs, regardless of whether they are led by humans and/or by digital systems, mainly address older adults with chronic diseases, and only a few of them are conceived from a preventive perspective, targeting older adults in good health conditions and/or in transition to retirement [19].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: On the contrary, healthy ageing strategies, including, for example, self-management capabilities, goal setting, personalised feedback and health literacy, as well as emotional support, reminders and alerts, could be highly effective for such a group of older adults, especially if in transition to retirement.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Nevertheless, such strategies cannot often be managed by healthcare professionals because the available workforce cannot be devoted to education and prevention, being on the frontline of assistance to older patients with acute and chronic care needs.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Thus, digital coaching technologies can offer an innovative way to overcome this lack of assistance and care as dialogue systems that sense relevant context, determine users’ intent, and provide feedback to improve users’ overall quality of life [20].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Therefore, digital coaching systems could be any computer program that supports spoken, text-based or multimodal conversational interactions with humans, such as personal digital assistants, virtual personal assistants, conversational agents or chats [21], reinforces and sustains healthy behavioural habits, and continuously monitors daily activities.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: There is still scant literature on the experience of older adults with digital coaching systems, but recent research showed that relatively young older adults may perceive digital coaching as a potential to motivate them towards physical activity by providing instructive information and motivational feedback [22].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Unfortunately, the efficacy of personal health coaching systems for adults over 55 remains unclear, and few examples are mapped in the field for older adults and even less for older people in transition from work to retirement [19,20].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: This study is part of the AgeWell project aimed at co-designing and developing a digital coaching system (hereafter also referred to as Digital Coach-DC) targeting older adults aged 55 and over in the transition from work to retirement.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The study aims to evaluate the impact of a digital coaching intervention to enhance physical activity, mental well-being, and socialization as three healthy ageing dimensions and help a meaningful retirement process as a factor influencing healthy ageing.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: It represents a novel contribution to assessing the value of digital coaching systems in a target population often overlooked by research on the development of this kind of technical solution.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The purpose of the study was to answer three research questions: (1) To what extent can the AgeWell digital coach improve physical activity, mental well-being, social networking and the retirement process of older adults switching from work to retirement? (2) What was the experience of users with the digital coach? (3) What are the strengths and weaknesses of the system?

### 2.2. Study Design

In order to answer the three research questions, the study followed a mixed-methods design in which both qualitative (QUANT) and quantitative (QUAL) data were collected at three measurement times during the 10-week field trial.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: A concurrent equal status interactive mixed-methods research was adopted, where the QUANT and QUAL data components collection and analyses were executed simultaneously, having, therefore, the same value and being in constant interaction [23,24,25,26,27].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Two parallel QUANT and QUAL strands were integrated into meta-inferences after separate analyses were carried out.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Thereafter, QUANT and QUAL results were brought together in the overall interpretation.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The QUANT analysis was aimed at highlighting the effects of the digital coach on the physical health, mental well-being, socialization and retirement transition of participants (research questions 1 and 2).
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The QUAL analysis aimed at shedding light on the strengths and weaknesses of both the digital coach contents and technical aspects (research question 3).
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The point of integration of the two analyses was reached when the QUAL findings were added and integrated into the QUANT in order to explain to what extent the digital coach influenced users’ lifestyles and how much such an influence can be attributed to the system’s weaknesses and strengths.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: As shown in Figure 4, in the first 5 weeks (Phase 1), participants were trained to use the digital coach by two human coaches, i.e., facilitators who constantly offered motivation, supported users’ confidence with the technology, provided technical skills and knowledge, and were responsible for the engagement of users.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: After the first 5 weeks (Phase 2), study participants continued to use the system without any help from the human coach.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

QUANT and QUAL Data Analysis

source_units.text: A probability value of <0.05 was considered statistically significant.

## 4. Discussion

The novelty of the study lies in testing the impact of a digital coach in motivating elders aged 55 and older in transition to retirement, an overlooked group of users, to adopt healthy ageing lifestyles through several activities proposed via four functionalities addressing healthy ageing components, i.e., physical activity, mental well-being, and socialization and retirement.

Towards Tailored and Attractive Digital Coach Systems

QUANT findings showed that the use of the AgeWell digital coach improved participants’ level of physical activity, mental well-being, and self-efficacy during the first 5 weeks of experimentation, when users were supported by the human coach. It is nevertheless worth noting that after the human coach stopped his/her activity, this positive effect continued only for the physical activity, but not for the mental well-being and self-efficacy. On the one hand, these QUANT results suggest that the digital coach systems can stabilize fluctuations in the physical activity performed by older adults before and after retirement [10,11].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: On the other hand, the users’ desire to have periodical meetings with the human coach, evidenced by the QUAL results, may suggest that, for this generation of older adults, it is still important to have the mediation of a human coach to also effect their mental well-being, which is exposed to risk during the retirement process [3,13].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: This suggests that the current version of digital health coaching systems cannot fully replace human-led interventions and may not be as effective as those led by human coaches [14,15,16,17,18].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Moreover, QUANT findings tell us that the level of socialization among participants worsened as the trial proceeded during both the human and the digital coach-driven phase.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: A possible explanation of this result may lie in the fact that, although the number of opportunities for social contacts increased thanks to the periodical distance meetings with the human coach and other users, the virtual nature of these contacts was not so gratifying and satisfying as to improve the perception of the quality of participants’ social ties.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: In fact, the trial took place between May and October 2021, when many social restrictions were still in force due to the COVID-19 pandemic, and elders participating in the experimentation might have suffered from the medium-term effects of two years of physical distancing.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: As a result, they might need personal contact with peers to experience meaningful relationships, as in the pre-pandemic period.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: In fact, although the QUAL findings show that several participants, especially in Italy, appreciated the function of the digital coach stimulating them to keep in contact with friends and relatives, this was not sufficient to improve participants’ capability of increasing the number or the quality of social ties.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The existing literature agrees on the fact that technology can improve many dimensions of social connection among older adults, e.g., by communicating and sharing not only pictures and media but also emotions and states of mind and by reading news and books [52,53,54].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: This highlights the need to design digital coaching systems that are capable of doing this and accordingly improve socialization among older adults.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Furthermore, both QUANT and QUAL results showed that user experience with the system was not positive in either country.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: In fact, users found the system unintuitive, not user-friendly and not flexible.

source_units.text: Dutch users were particularly attentive to the technical aspects, which is probably due to a greater diffusion of digital systems in this country and to greater digital health literacy among its senior citizens compared to their Italian counterparts, which led them to have higher expectations regarding digital coach systems.

source_units.text: ### 4.2. Strengths and Limitations
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The strength of the study is the adoption of a mixed-method approach, which allowed the interpretation of apparently contradictory findings highlighted by QUANT and QUAL tools.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Although the QUAL results highlighted the capability of the system to stimulate older adults to behave in a way more oriented to healthy ageing principles, the numerous technical issues might have confounded the users’ perception of the contents and dimmed the full potential of the app in helping elderly people smoothly cross the line of retirement.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: This represented a significant limitation of the study, together with the low number of participants, whose recruitment was hindered by the COVID-19 pandemic only in Italy and The Netherlands.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Moreover, it was hard to engage older workers in the trial because they had more time constraints than retirees, who represented the majority of the sample.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: In addition, as a limitation of the study design, the lack of a control group, as well as the length of the trial, did not permit us to go in depth into the effectiveness of the system.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: All these limitations did not allow for a generalization of results.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Therefore, future large sample studies are encouraged to assess the impact and the effectiveness of digital coach systems in promoting healthy ageing within this elderly population group.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Finally, the use of a usable and tailored digital coach may have a positive impact not only on older individuals but also at the company level if we consider older adults near retirement as older workers from a work and human capital perspective [59].

source_units.text: In fact, although there is no difference in productivity between younger and older workers, the latter have more absenteeism than the former [60], representing a huge loss in productivity, as hugely emerged during the COVID-19 outbreak [61].

# 5. Conclusions

This study showed that a digital coaching program can be a valuable tool to stimulate older adults to adopt healthy lifestyles while they cross the line of retirement, especially by triggering physical activity.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: On the contrary, mental well-being and socialization remain the most difficult healthy ageing dimensions to be addressed by digital coach technology.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Thus, there is still a need for the support of a human coach in attaining positive mid-term outcomes in these realms.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Within this study, some empirical evidence about the characteristics that a coaching system must possess have been highlighted: flexibility, to address the needs of this specific target; being interesting and attractive, to stimulate proactivity and healthy ageing habits during this existential change; and offering a polite communication mode exchange, since elders in retirement want to maintain control over their life and time.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Indeed, the level of personalization of such coaching systems remains the golden key to aligning the health program to the physical, cognitive and social status of the intended target.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: In addition, it can significantly impact the quality of the user-system interaction, usability, and acceptability, as well as enhance adherence to the intervention.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Even if technology-based interventions such as coaching systems are an emerging field in the healthcare domain, it seems that there is still a lack of evaluations to discover the added value of this innovation.
